post_event.title: Post an ADP event
post_event.description: ADP's universal write. Every change -- hiring, terminating, changing a name, an address, a deduction -- is an event posted to `/events/{domain}/{version}/{event-name}`, and this tool reaches any of them, including events this pack has no typed tool for. Domains are `hr`, `payroll`, `time`, `staffing` and `core`; event names look like `worker.hire` or `worker.business-communication.email.change`. Call `get_event_metadata` for the same event first: it returns the payload shape and the code values this client accepts.

domain.description: The event domain, e.g. hr, payroll, time, staffing or core.

event_name.description: The event name, e.g. worker.hire or worker.legal-name.change.

event.description: The event payload -- typically {"events": [{"data": {...}}]} as the event's own metadata describes.

event_version.description: Version segment of the event, usually v1 or v2.

output.description: ADP's confirmation, including any events it generated.

events.description: The events ADP recorded, with their ids.

get_event_metadata.title: Get an event's payload schema
get_event_metadata.description: What one event accepts on this client's configuration: its fields, which are required, and the code values each code field permits. ADP's code lists are per-client, so this is the check that stops an event being rejected for an unknown reason code. Works for every event, including the ones with typed tools below.

domain.description: The event domain, e.g. hr, payroll, time, staffing or core.

event_version.description: Version segment of the event, usually v1 or v2.

output.description: The event's metadata.

meta.description: The event's fields and the code values this client accepts.
